subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When the planner's frozen assurance and impl-review's actual proposal band are available for one exact revision, the review orchestrator shall apply this closed join: `ordinary×skip→standard×1`, `ordinary×standard→standard×1`, `ordinary×deep→deep×1`, every `elevated` cell→`deep×1`, and every `critical` cell→`deep×2`; neither input may reduce the other's depth or the planned pass count, and an assurance pass means one top-level review rather than an internal remediation round.
rationale: workload-independent consequences provide the minimum, actual proposal risk may only add scrutiny, and critical changes need corroboration
fit_criterion: exhaustive 3×3 fixtures produce exactly the declared depth/count cells and all nine yield one or two passes; a zero-pass attempt fails under UB-16; every pass binds one identical proposal revision; remediation-miscount fixtures fail
